lane_map.description: Device Layer, action gates, device discovery, continuity, approval/lockback, and final authority boundary.
Discovery, sentinel enrichment, onboarding review, identity confirmation, human review, reviewed asset enrichment, and readiness map.
Printer IPP, phone satellite, router status, and related read-only protocol lanes.
LeeWay-Standards authority, law registry, schema, risk vocabulary, proof receipt lockback, and final summary.
Runtime Fabric authority binding, inventory, layer classification, kernel/container/model registries, risk matrix, UI policy, alignment, env-root closure.
Agent Lee governed binding readiness, contract, and receipt.
Native SDK readiness, packaging contract, package creation gates, and packaging hold/reroute.
Docker-focused layer inventory, Docker-contained coherence, evidence consolidation, and upcoming execution readiness gates.
Operator repair tools, launchers, monitors, recovery tools, and execution-layer helpers. Included for archive evidence; not all should become runtime package code.

carry_forward_classes.reason: Existing governance should be reused, not recreated.
Scripts prove how the system was built and are needed for audit/recovery.
Runtime JSON records are canonical evidence of governance outcomes.
Proof receipts are the audit chain.
Docker container/image/network/volume inventory defines the package runtime surface.
Live logs can be volatile, locked, oversized, and environment-specific. Include only selected receipt logs, not raw live streams.
Secrets must never be packaged as raw evidence.
Dependencies/build artifacts should be restored by package manifests, not carried as evidence.

governance_reuse_rules.rule: Do not recreate Device Layer governance if scripts/receipts 160-400 exist and are clean.
Do not recreate LeeWay-Standards governance if scripts/receipts 401-407 exist and are clean.
Do not recreate Runtime Fabric governance if scripts/receipts 408-422 exist and are clean.
Do not recreate Agent Lee binding if scripts/receipts 423-425 exist and are clean.
Do not recreate Discovery Layer governance if phase 287-319 and Sentinel/Identity/Human Review artifacts exist; rebind and reassemble instead.
Packaging/distribution must stay paused until executable reality proof closes.
Docker containers should reference canonical evidence from E: Archive/runtime, not become the primary evidence store.
Final package must include canonical evidence index and carry-forward manifest.

next_phase_needs: Run 435B if not already clean to verify the operator evidence mirror.
Run 436 to resolve Discovery Layer using existing governance instead of recreating it.
Run 437 to reassemble Discovery binding map.
Run 438 to close high-risk container gate matrix.
Run 439 to lock active execution scope.
Run 440 to define Standards-bound safe execution approval gate.
Only after execution proofs are real should packaging resume.
Final package must include this carry-forward manifest.
Final package must exclude secrets and volatile live logs.
Docker containers must reference E: Archive/runtime evidence, not own the canonical proof chain.
